name: Legacy SQL / RDL Report Library
livePromotion: Hold. Live code and Power Platform publishing require explicit authorization.
features: Reports page: IT Admin-only legacy report selector, date/fiscal/quarter/program parameters and source/dependency inspection; unavailable in View as User.

All 25 report layouts use native app code. The 40 views and 86 dataset queries are offline-compiled to static allowlisted SELECT/CTE/UNION/window plans with indexed joins, SQL null semantics, dates, decimals, grouping and correlated aggregate support. No production SQL engine, worker, WASM, eval or executable source downloads.

RDL native tables preserve row/column grouping, filters, sorts, computed fields, aggregate scopes, typed formats and editable per-tab mapping setup. Collapsible details can be expanded; large detail lists have 500-row paging.
Thin selected-column reads across every Dataverse page, archive filtering, lookup target/type verification, actual choice decoding, duplicate-row detection, progress and cancellation.
Helpline replaces old PhoneLog/ProgramEnrollment call paths, once per call; unlinked callers retain distinct call GUIDs rather than a shared invented client.
Program Enrollment funder lookup takes precedence; verified legacy funder choices are used and reported when the new lookup is empty.
Unknown/Not Reported client demographic choices normalize to legacy unknown/data-not-collected categories for source CASE expressions.

App Record IDs shown in report output; full datasets and mapping configuration downloadable. Original SQL/RDL files untouched; server connections, links, credentials and executable VB code not bundled.

Report runs have no Dataverse writes or persistent database copies. An explicit IT Admin action can set the Client Profile report exclusion choice; it does not change child records, archive status or app visibility. The customized DES top-two-section prototype uses the same eligibility policy.

Client Profile cmps_excludefromreports Yes 125570000 excludes the profile and directly or enrollment-linked records; otherwise included, subject to archive filtering. No name or creator heuristics. Original SQL Test-name exclusions are removed only from the compiled calculation plans, leaving source files intact.

Every source table must have verified cmps_isarchived choice metadata. Server filters and defensive checks on every returned page exclude archived rows. Missing archive or Client Profile exclusion metadata makes dependent datasets unavailable instead of scanning unfiltered data. Archived/excluded parents cannot reappear as anonymous Helpline callers; genuine unlinked calls remain.

IT Admin Report Inclusion controls are inline in the existing profile action rows on the summary and full view, not a standalone nested panel that could create implicit grid columns. Ordinary users and View as User cannot interact; permission is rechecked before writes. Changes are confirmed by rereading the saved profile and include cmps_modifiedby where available. Existing report results must be rerun.

DES DV Monthly Report - Exhibit E retains its confirmed custom counting rules and seven source-layout sections. Every other report now uses the static native calculation evaluator through the existing Dataverse connector.

Native DES uses confirmed October-September resets, continuing-enrollment counts and the one DV Outreach transfer exception. TANF is read from Enrollment; DOB supplies age, with optional flagged Client Type fallback. Non-TANF child inclusion and DV Outreach first Service versus Enrollment date are configurable.

Native exits use actual period end dates, not artificial end dates for open enrollments or the client's first-served month. Turnaways are separated from People Served. Completed bed-enrollment nights are clipped to the period/current date; transitional stays are combined, overlaps flagged.

MCBA service categories are explicitly configurable, including current Intake & Discharge and actual labels discovered in report data. No Victim Advocacy replacement is guessed. Category exclusions and data issues are reported; full record-level audit and setup can be downloaded.

Native service reads are scoped to October 1 history through the selected/current date, and bed reads to overlapping stays. Date mappings/types are metadata-verified; full connector paging and archive filters remain in force. Indexed joins and cooperative progress/cancellation handle large cohorts.
unavailablePolicy: Reference-dependent datasets and invalid current-schema mappings are marked unavailable, not silently replaced with zero totals. Native date-range DES calculations use confirmed October counting history and do not need deferred calendar/capacity rows; their Fiscal_Year and Quarter labels stay blank. Other datasets in the selected report can still run.

performance: No production report path imports DuckDB or emits worker/WASM build assets. Native DES scopes service/bed reads. Shared native plans cache source/view results, use hash joins including parenthesized equality conditions, cache group aggregates and cooperate with progress/cancellation. Legacy history needed for first-served queries is not truncated to an arbitrary record count.
